summary: This is a VectorBuilder experimental report dated August 14, 2025, documenting customized AAV production and transduction testing in the Calu-6 (lung cancer) cell line. The study evaluates six AAV9 variants (large-scale and ultra-purified medium-scale) across three vector constructs using Western Blot (anti-p53) and RNA extraction/QC as readouts. Key findings include differential p53 expression by vector/purification type and a consistent ~27–130x drop in target RNA levels in ultra-purified vs. large-scale AAV preparations.

content_blocks.title: Cover Page – Study Overview
content_blocks.content: Title: 'Customized AAV production and transduction test with Calu-6 cell line (RNA extraction and Western Blot)'. Sales Order: S250613-1039jjn / P250610-1004gsu. Date: 2025/8/14. Conducted by VectorBuilder. Study involves AAV9 transduction of Calu-6 cells with downstream RNA extraction and Western Blot analysis.

content_blocks.title: Materials – Virus List and Titers
content_blocks.content:
Cell line: Calu-6 (from ATCC, passage 3). Transduction format: 24-well plates / 6-well plates. Cell numbers: 3E+4 cells (24-well) / 8E+4 cells (6-well). MOI: 5E+6.

Viruses tested (all under Sales Order S250613-1039jjn):
1. AAV9L(VB240514-1548ggn) – Lot 250617AAVM01 – Titer: 2.06E+12 GC/ml
2. AAV9MP(VB240514-1548ggn) – Lot 250618AAVY17 – Titer: 1.54E+13 GC/ml
3. AAV9MP(VB250610-1157tpv) – Lot 250702AAVP15 – Titer: 5.39E+12 GC/ml
4. AAV9MP(VB250610-1162rmu) – Lot 250703AAVN13 – Titer: 1.00E+13 GC/ml
5. AAV9L(VB250610-1162rmu) – Lot 250702AAVU01 – Titer: 2.38E+12 GC/ml
6. AAV9L(VB250610-1157tpv) – Lot 250712AAVW01 – Titer: 3.47E+12 GC/ml

AAV9L = large-scale; AAV9MP = ultra-purified medium scale.

content_blocks.title: Protocol – Western Blot and RNA Extraction Parameters
content_blocks.content:
Western Blot Protocol:
- Harvest time: 72h post-transduction
- Cell lysis: 100 µl RIPA lysis buffer per 24-well plate
- Sample treatment: Ultrasonic disruption + 95°C for 10 min
- Protein loaded: 10 µg
- SDS-PAGE: 80V for 30 min, then 125V for 1 hour
- Transfer: 250 mA for 60 min
- Primary antibody: Overnight at 4°C
- Secondary antibody: 1 hour at room temperature

RNA Extraction Protocol (6-well plate, MOI=5E+6):
- Harvest time: 72h post-transduction
- Reagent: TRIzol® (Invitrogen™ Cat# 15596026)
- Method: Per Invitrogen™ 15596026 procedural guidelines

content_blocks.title: Bright Field Microscopy Images – Cell Morphology Post-Transduction
content_blocks.content:
Bright field images (10 ms exposure) of Calu-6 cells 72h post-transduction with six AAV variants: AAV9L(VB240514-1548ggn), AAV9MP(VB240514-1548ggn), AAV9L(VB250610-1157tpv), AAV9MP(VB250610-1157tpv), AAV9L(VB250610-1162rmu), AAV9MP(VB250610-1162rmu). Controls: Calu6 WT and G418 (2000 µg/ml) treated cells.

Key observation: Cells transduced with non-purified (large-scale) virus showed more cell debris than those transduced with ultra-purified virus, suggesting greater cytotoxicity from the large-scale preparations.

content_blocks.title: Western Blot Results – VB240514-1548ggn and VB250610-1157tpv (Anti-p53 and Anti-GAPDH)
content_blocks.content:
Western blot performed on Calu-6 cells 72h post-transduction. Two antibodies used: Anti-p53 (50 kDa, 45s exposure) and Anti-GAPDH (35 kDa, 10s exposure as loading control).

Lane assignments:
1: AAV9L(VB240514-1548ggn)
2: AAV9L(VB240514-1548ggn) duplicate
3: AAV9MP(VB240514-1548ggn)
4: AAV9MP(VB240514-1548ggn) duplicate
5: AAV9L(VB250610-1157tpv)
6: AAV9L(VB250610-1157tpv) duplicate
7: AAV9MP(VB250610-1157tpv)
8: AAV9MP(VB250610-1157tpv) duplicate
9: G418 2000 µg/mL
10: Positive control
11: Calu6 WT
12: Calu6 WT

Observations: Strong p53 bands visible in lanes 1, 2 (AAV9L VB240514-1548ggn) and lanes 5, 6 (AAV9L VB250610-1157tpv). Weaker or absent p53 bands in ultra-purified (AAV9MP) lanes 3, 4, 7, 8. GAPDH loading control shows consistent loading across lanes.

RNA QC data (Ct Mean by Arraystar):
- VB240514-1548ggn large-scale: Ct ~10.08 (166 ng/µl, 129 ng/µl)
- VB240514-1548ggn ultra-purified: Ct ~17.11 (303 ng/µl, 325 ng/µl)
- VB250610-1157tpv large-scale: Ct ~12.69 (162 ng/µl, 236 ng/µl)
- VB250610-1157tpv ultra-purified: Ct ~17.44 (226 ng/µl, 340 ng/µl)

content_blocks.title: Western Blot Results – VB250610-1162rmu (Anti-p53 and Anti-GAPDH)
content_blocks.content:
Second Western blot panel for VB250610-1162rmu vector. Same antibodies: Anti-p53 (50 kDa, 45s) and Anti-GAPDH (35 kDa, 10s).

Lane assignments:
1: Calu6 WT

3: AAV9L(VB250610-1162rmu)

5: AAV9MP(VB250610-1162rmu)

7: G418 2000 µg/mL
8: Positive control

Observations: Strong p53 band in lane 4 (AAV9L duplicate). Weaker bands in lanes 3, 5, 6. GAPDH loading control consistent.

RNA QC data (Ct Mean by Arraystar):
- VB250610-1162rmu large-scale: Ct 11.517 (214 ng/µl), Ct 10.611 (216 ng/µl)
- VB250610-1162rmu ultra-purified: Ct 17.092 (257 ng/µl), Ct 17.567 (411 ng/µl)

content_blocks.title: Raw Ct Values Chart – Grouped by Vector and Purification Type
content_blocks.content:
Bar chart showing raw Ct values (y-axis) for each vector/purification combination. Red dashed line at Ct=25 (threshold). WT Control bar approaches Ct=25.

Summary table of ΔCt and fold-change in tRNA:

Vector | Large-scale Ct | Ultra-purified Ct | ΔCt (Ultra–Large) | Approx. fold drop in tRNA (Ultra vs Large)
VB240514-1548ggn | 10.08 | 17.11 | 7.02 | ~130×
VB250610-1157tpv | 12.69 | 17.44 | 4.75 | ~27×
VB250610-1162rmu | 11.06 | 17.33 | 6.27 | ~77×

Interpretation: Large-scale (non-purified) AAV preparations result in substantially lower Ct values (higher RNA signal/knockdown) compared to ultra-purified medium-scale preparations. The WT control Ct (~24.7) is near the threshold, confirming baseline expression. Large-scale virus shows 27–130× more target RNA reduction than ultra-purified virus.

key_findings: Six AAV9 variants (3 vector constructs × 2 purification types: large-scale [AAV9L] and ultra-purified medium-scale [AAV9MP]) were tested for transduction efficiency in Calu-6 (lung cancer) cells at MOI=5E+6, with cells harvested 72h post-transduction.

Western Blot with Anti-p53 antibody shows stronger p53 protein expression in cells transduced with large-scale (non-purified) AAV9L preparations compared to ultra-purified AAV9MP preparations, suggesting higher transduction efficiency or different biological activity of large-scale virus.

RNA QC (Ct values by Arraystar) demonstrates that large-scale AAV preparations produce substantially lower Ct values (higher target RNA signal) vs. ultra-purified: ΔCt of 7.02 (~130× fold difference) for VB240514-1548ggn, 4.75 (~27×) for VB250610-1157tpv, and 6.27 (~77×) for VB250610-1162rmu.
WT Calu-6 control Ct values (~24.7) are near the detection threshold (Ct=25), confirming low baseline target RNA expression and validating the assay sensitivity.

Bright field microscopy shows more cell debris in cells transduced with non-purified (large-scale) virus vs. ultra-purified virus, indicating greater cytotoxicity from large-scale preparations despite higher transduction efficiency.
All RNA samples show intact RNA bands on agarose gel, confirming successful RNA extraction quality across all 14 samples.
Virus titers ranged from 2.06E+12 GC/ml (AAV9L VB240514-1548ggn) to 1.54E+13 GC/ml (AAV9MP VB240514-1548ggn), with ultra-purified preparations generally achieving higher titers.
The study is a preclinical in vitro experiment using a commercial cell line (Calu-6, ATCC, P3), consistent with early-stage (TRL 2-3) vector development and optimization.
